envelope.description: Daemon request to review an existing design artifact, and the MCP stream helpers

body.title: Daemon request to review an existing design artifact, and the MCP stream helpers
body.summary: Register a daemon stream method, workflow.review, that takes an artifact path and runs reviewArtifactFile with the provider resolved for the review role, streaming progress and a final frame. The same-party refusal added in t4 is what produces its error frame for daemon-authored work, which is why this task follows t4. Add two MCP helpers, one for it and one for codeReview.run, built like the workflow-run helper but treating a plain line with a top-level error and no stream field as a final failure, and one with a top-level result and no stream field as a protocol error.
acceptanceChecks: workflow.review on a controller-authored artifact streams progress and ends with a done frame carrying the verdict and reviewedBy daemon; on a daemon-authored one it ends with an error frame
Each helper resolves on the done frame and rejects on an error frame, on a connection error and on a close before the final frame
A fake daemon that answers with a plain unknown-method line and keeps the socket open makes each helper reject at once, not at its timer

tests.name: T12 workflow.review streams progress and a done frame for controller-authored work and an error frame for daemon-authored work
T11 each stream helper resolves on done and rejects on an error frame, a connection error and an early close
T11 a plain unknown-method line with the socket kept open makes each helper reject at once, not at its timer
